title: MolSanity: a reliability audit for feature attributions on molecular graph neural networks
description:
MolSanity audits existing feature-attribution methods for molecular graph neural networks rather than proposing a new one. Every (dataset, backbone, attributor, split) combination is scored on six axes: motif-native coherence, occlusion–attribution faithfulness, ground-truth localisation where node labels exist, cross-checkpoint stability, calibration linkage, and confidence/correctness regime stratification.

This archive contains the trained GNN checkpoints, the per-molecule audit records, the run manifest (seed, library versions, hardware), and the scripts that regenerate every figure and table of the accompanying manuscript from those artifacts.
